name: capsaicin + menthol + methyl salicylate
uses: Uses: Temporarily relieves mild aches and pains of muscles or joints.
otcwarn: Do Not Use: on open wounds, cuts, damaged or infected skin as well as in the eyes, mouth, genitals, or any other mucous membranes. Consult your physician: if pain is persistent or worsens or if using any other topical pain products.
